# Welcome to the Documentation Portal

This portal contains guides to help you understand and use the application.

## How to use this documentation

Use the navigation on the left to browse subjects and topics. The **On this page** panel on the right lists chapters from the current document.

## Documentation structure

Each topic links to an independent Markdown file. Headings in that file automatically appear in the right-side table of contents.

## Need help?

Contact your system administrator or support team if you need assistance.
